references: O14 decision: sparse ED is the primary exact same-Hamiltonian reference for W3b doped/magnetized rows; Bethe real-root scans are non-blocking cross-checks only where validated.

basis_convention.onsite_term: FCIDUMP two-electron integral (i i i i) = U
basis_convention.one_body_term: h_{i,i+1}=h_{i+1,i}=-t with periodic edge, all other h_{ij}=0
basis_convention.o14_filling_convention: Rows are labeled by actual total filling n = N_e / L. L=12 sectors are Ne=10 and Ne=8, not nominal n=0.8 or n=0.6 claims.

features.bethe_cross_check_note: O14 makes ED primary for W3b; existing real-root scans are retained only as non-blocking diagnostics and do not validate these emitted target sectors.
features.basis_convention_note: FCIDUMP spatial orbitals are Hubbard sites, not Hartree-Fock orbitals; ECORE=0 and no particle-hole shift.

requirements.reference_energy_method: sparse exact diagonalization (Lanczos) of finite periodic Hubbard FCIDUMP Hamiltonian
reference_energy_cross_validation_method: independent sparse ED verifier from FCIDUMP integrals
requirements.reference_energy_source: O14 W3b route: sparse Lanczos exact diagonalization of the same finite periodic site-basis Hubbard Hamiltonian emitted as FCIDUMP; Lieb-Wu real-root scans are non-blocking cross-checks only when same-target validation exists.
requirements.reference_energy_note: Lanczos tolerance 1e-12; Hilbert dimension 44100. Actual total filling n=N_e/L=0.8.
